versions.changelog:
No file changes detected in this version.

- No functional or documentation changes.
- Version incremented for maintenance or procedural reasons only.

Amber Url to Markdown 3.2.3

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md, removing sections on author, license, and tags for a cleaner overview.
- Minor content reorganization in documentation; core functionality and usage remain unchanged.
- No user-facing logic changes in extraction or conversion scripts.

- Improved scripts/parser.py logic (details not specified).
- Updated _meta.json metadata.
- No changes to the user-facing SKILL.md documentation in this version.

Amber URL to Markdown 3.2.1

- Major refactor introducing a new extensible handler-based architecture (V4) under scripts/handlers/
- Added support for Doubao site in addition to WeChat, Zhihu, Juejin, and other platforms
- New documentation files: setup, limitations, release notes, and architectural notes for V4
- Main script and modules updated to integrate the modular handler structure
- Keeps original features (auto-trigger via Hook, multi-site markdown conversion, local image download) with improved extensibility
新增 url-auto-fetch Hook，实现真正的自动触发功能

Version 3.1.0 introduces major refactoring and optimizations.

- Added modular core scripts: async_fetcher.py, config.py, fetcher.py, pagination.py, parser.py, and utils.py for better maintainability and extensibility.
- Introduced automated testing with tests/test_amber_url_to_markdown.py and a test runner script.
- Added Python packaging files (pyproject.toml, requirements.txt) for improved dependency management.
- Enhanced documentation and change logs with new markdown files.
- Refactored and optimized main and third-party scripts for performance and reliability improvements.

Amber Url to Markdown v2.2.0

- 新增 AI 触发行为约定：用户发送“纯 URL”或“URL+意图关键词”时自动执行并报告结果
- 明确触发条件及自动执行规则，便于集成到聊天/自动化环境
- 输出目录结构优化：Markdown 文件集中存储，图片按时间戳分组，引用路径调整
- 文档全面更新，详细说明触发场景、输出规范和使用方式

Amber_Url_to_Markdown v2.1.0

- 增加对 CSDN 和 Medium 网站的 Markdown 内容抓取支持。
- 完善依赖说明及安装指引，增强用户操作体验。
- 文档结构优化，明确输出目录与降级抓取策略。
- 支持命令行与 Python 两种调用方式。
- 强调图片本地下载与完整 Markdown 格式保留。
